title: BARMM government urged to intervene as fuel prices soar in Tawi-Tawi

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Prices of gasoline and diesel in Tawi-Tawi have soared to P140 and P110 per liter, respectively, allegedly due to supply shortage, according to a Bangsamoro Parliament member who sought the intervention of the regional government as the situation has adversely affected transport and fishing livelihoods in the island-province.
